sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा निर्धुतान् रामो दुष्टो ऽयमिति राक्षसः।सुमुत्पपात वेगेन धनुरुत्तममाददे ।। ६.६७.१२१ ।।
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā nirdhutān rāmo duṣṭo 'yamiti rākṣasaḥ।sumutpapāta vegena dhanuruttamamādade ।। 6.67.121 ।।

translations.english: Adorned by peacock's plumes, those arrows slipped into his breast, he lost senses, his mace naturally dropped down from his hand.
